title: Add exact text interchange alongside host values
context: Legacy JS binary64 loses 9007199254740993; narrowing Standard 0.1 would break compatibility.
decision: Add immutable numeric tokens, original source and versioned decimal-v1 output; retain host APIs.
rationale: Separate preservation from native ergonomics and avoid an arithmetic system or mandatory SDK.
alternativesConsidered: Restrict all core numbers: incompatible narrowing
Raw text only: cannot validate precise confidence bounds
Arbitrary arithmetic: unnecessary for preservation and comparison
